title: Desvignes's orchestra and reading drum parts
summary: Desvignes led a reading orchestra, which meant drum parts, unlike the small faking bands.

blocks.x: What kind of band was Sidney Desweeney's?
Would you call that a Dixieland band or a Reedin band or both? Well, it was a Reedin band. It was an orchestra. It was an orchestra.
Now, did you get drum parts to play with that?
